categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: conductive film products mainly for computer keyboards; automotive electronics including high-definition digital camera modules, 3D AVM panoramic imaging systems, driver monitoring systems (DMS), occupant monitoring systems (OMS), and advanced vehicle control units (ECU); and special vehicles such as golf carts, personal transportation vehicles, sightseeing vehicles, utility vehicles, and related parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced conductive film technology for keyboard switches, automotive-grade camera and ECU module development with ASPICE CL2 and ISO26262 certifications, and electric vehicle manufacturing technologies including lightweight aluminum chassis design, battery management systems with 4G connectivity, and autonomous driving system development. Production involves cleanroom environments, automated assembly lines, and integration of hardware, software, and algorithm development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major OEM/ODM manufacturers in the computer and communication industries for conductive films, automotive OEMs primarily in China and Southeast Asia for automotive electronics, and distributors and end-users in golf courses, resorts, airports, and community transportation markets globally for special vehicles. The company serves both domestic and international markets with a focus on Asia, the US, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities and sales in Taiwan, mainland China (notably Jiaxing and Chongqing), Southeast Asia (Thailand, India), and exports to the US, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. It is expanding global production footprint to mitigate geopolitical risks and trade tariffs, especially for automotive and special vehicle segments.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing key components such as conductive films and automotive camera modules, and assembling finished special vehicles. It sources raw materials like PET, conductive inks, sensors, and electronic components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products to OEMs and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening automotive electronics market penetration, expanding global customer base, enhancing R&D capabilities in high-resolution automotive cameras and autonomous driving systems, and developing platform-based products for efficiency. The company emphasizes innovation in AI-integrated vehicle systems, battery technology, and smart vehicle controls, while pursuing global production diversification and supply chain resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of conductive films, automotive electronic modules, and special vehicles. The company operates on OEM/ODM contracts with major clients, with no indication of subscription or licensing models. Sales are made directly to industrial customers and distributors across multiple regions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In conductive films, competitors include Kede, Chuan Yi, Sheng Fang, Xing Xie He, and Jia Feng with similar product offerings. In automotive electronics, competition arises from Chinese optical lens companies and traditional security firms entering the automotive camera market, with international Tier 1 suppliers like Bosch and Aptiv dominating ADAS solutions. For special vehicles, major global competitors are Club Car, E-Z-GO, and Yamaha, with Chinese brands like Zhuoyue and Greenway also active. The company positions itself as a quality-focused, innovative player with international certifications and a growing global footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.615 billion in 2024, a 25.29% increase from the previous year. It achieved a net profit of NT$127.6 million, recovering from prior losses. Total assets reached about NT$3.02 billion, with equity of NT$1.99 billion. The company shows a positive growth trajectory supported by strategic acquisitions and expanding product lines, with stable financial health and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, stable supply of conductive films with cost-effective manufacturing, advanced automotive camera and ECU systems certified to international automotive standards, and customizable, durable electric special vehicles with smart features. Its differentiation lies in integrated R&D capabilities, global production layout to mitigate geopolitical risks, and strong customer relationships enabling tailored solutions and innovation leadership in automotive AI imaging and electric vehicle platforms.
